title: Summing in half precision
summary: What happens when a long sum is accumulated in FP16, and why kernels accumulate in FP32.

choices.text: 100,000 exactly, because 1.0 is exactly representable in FP16.
`inf`, because the sum overflows past the FP16 maximum of 65,504.
2,048: from there the step between FP16 numbers is 2, so adding 1 rounds back to the same value.
About 99,900, because each add loses about 10⁻³ of relative precision.
